Downstream dependency pricing-engine error_rate stayed flat at ~0.22% with zero WARN/ERROR logs in the window; no dependency-side errors.

The error is deterministic across many distinct accounts (99733, 10578, 79537, 57680, 32892, ...) — essentially every FNO order fails, not a subset tied to specific bad data.
